desc: Implement tree parsing and adjacency list construction.
Root the tree at vertex 1 and compute parent/children relationships via BFS/DFS.
Perform post-order traversal to process nodes from leaves to root.
For each node, collect pending path lengths from children, apply the greedy logic to determine if decomposition is possible and what pending length to pass up.
Check if the root returns 0 (all paths completed) and print "Yes" or "No".
